name: lookup_order
description: Look up a customer's order status, delivery estimate, and tracking information.

order_id.description: Order ID in the format ORD-XXXXXXX

name: query_policy
description: Search the NorthStar policy corpus. MUST call before answering a return, tier, window, fee, final-sale, exception, shipping, or other policy question, even when no order ID is available.

name: initiate_return
description: Initiate a return only after confirming eligibility and the customer's intent.

name: apply_loyalty_credit
description: Apply a policy-authorized loyalty credit. Credits above $50 are blocked by the policy engine.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Escalate an out-of-authority request without promising an exception. MUST call after a policy lookup for out-of-window or final-sale return requests; use customer_id UNKNOWN if unavailable. Do not ask the customer to approve the escalation first.

customer_id.description: Customer ID, or UNKNOWN when absent
